summary: A generated plan rendered as a list of checkable, editable steps.
purpose: Show the plan a mess unpacks into. Reach for it inside the plan modal to render ordered steps the user can complete; it composes TaskItem for each step.

anatomy.description: Optional friendly framing line above the steps.
A stack of TaskItem rows, each checkable.
A quiet message when there are no steps.

props.name: steps
props.description: The steps, each { id, text, isCompleted }.

props.name: onToggleStep
props.description: Called when a step is checked or unchecked.

props.name: intro
props.description: Optional friendly intro line above the steps.

props.name: onEditStep
props.description: Optional handler for editing a step's text.

props.name: onDeleteStep
props.description: Optional handler for removing a step.

whenToUse: Rendering a generated plan as ordered, checkable steps.
Inside the plan modal opened from a ProblemCard.

do: Keep steps small and doable, one action each.
Write an intro that sets a gentle, one-thing-at-a-time tone.
dont: Pack multiple actions into one step.
Use it for content the user cannot act on.

content.voice: Encouraging, concrete, one small action per step.
rules: Each step is a single doable action.

keyboard: Each step's checkable control is focusable and toggled with Space or Enter.
aria: Steps read as a list; each TaskItem exposes its completed state.
Completion is conveyed by more than color.
accessibility.contrast: Step text and intro hold at least 4.5:1; completed steps stay legible.
accessibility.focus: Visible focus on each step control.

related.whenToChoose: TaskItem is one step row; PlanStepList sequences many of them.
A ProblemCard's Unmess action opens the PlanStepList for that case.
PlanStepList is typically rendered inside a Dialog.
